scope: Only existing canonical Poaceae name/rank/synonym/concept review; no species-card edits, media, genus/family lessons, installation, county nativity audit, Pages, or schedule changes.

scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP 2026 accepts the existing canonical name as a Poaceae species, published in 1803; species-level name and genus are correct.
POWO separately accepts P. laeve, notwithstanding the historic combination P. laeve var. floridanum. Do not merge modern species concepts.
POWO separately accepts P. bifidum; this is the accepted destination of Panicum floridanum Trin., not P. floridanum Michx.
Homotypic synonym of P. floridanum; historical variety rank under P. laeve does not make the modern species P. laeve.
POWO treats this 1886 variety as heterotypic synonym under P. floridanum at species rank; retain historical varietal attribution for voucher review.
POWO treats the 1897 species-rank combination as synonym of P. floridanum, not a separately accepted learner card.
Current POWO/WCVP synonym destination is P. floridanum; older World Grass Species accepted the historical P. giganteum concept, so voucher identification needs caution.
POWO lists P. difforme as heterotypic synonym of accepted P. floridanum; source-specific morphologies are not automatically specimen-level identity proof.
POWO maps this historical name to P. floridanum; the original identification should remain searchable as an alias.
POWO maps Panicum floridanum Trin. (1834) to P. bifidum, despite sharing the floridanum epithet with Paspalum floridanum Michx. (1803).
POWO places the historic altissimum variety under P. floridanum, not modern accepted P. laeve.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Proposed name-only merge of Panicum floridanum Trin. into Paspalum floridanum Michx.
scientific_decisions.reason: The two names have different accepted destinations under POWO; epithet similarity does not establish synonymy. FAIL is for this hypothetical mapping only, not for accepted P. floridanum.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual photographs and historical vouchers labelled Paspalum floridanum
scientific_decisions.reason: Accepted taxon and name mapping do not verify individual photographed plants. Existing canonical card explicitly flags Commons source identification as not a local voucher; preserve all provisional photo/science status.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical specimens assigned Paspalum giganteum or var. glabratum
scientific_decisions.reason: Broad synonym treatment in POWO does not establish exact source-plant identity across historically segregated P. giganteum and glabratum forms. No automatic photo/observation reassignment.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical species treatment of Paspalum giganteum
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO 2026 synonymizes P. giganteum but its page notes World Grass Species 2006 accepted the name under an alternative taxonomy. The modern name mapping is PASS, but unvouchered older identifications remain concept-dependent.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Authorship ascribed to Paspalum floridanum var. glabratum in historical USFS versus POWO
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO cites var. glabratum Vasey; a USDA Forest Service account cites Engelm. ex Vasey. Original 1886 publication was not independently inspected, so do not silently replace accepted backbone authorship or infer a distinct taxon.

limitations: Taxonomy verification is not specimen/photo identification. Individual source photos and older vouchers remain on HOLD.

Kew POWO/WCVP accepted-name pages and indexed USDA Forest Service/WFO accounts were consulted; the complete 1886 protologue and full USDA PDF were not independently examined, so historical authorship discrepancy is UNRESOLVED.
No evidence was found establishing hybrid ancestry for the canonical specimen; no hybrid formula or parentage was assigned.
No county nativity audit, media, learner card, or website changes.
